title: Truncated Text
description: Links that cut long titles off with an ellipsis and render through TruncatedText, so the Tooltip shows the full text only while it is cut off, placed to the right with fitViewport, so long text wraps. Use it for truncated labels, file names, or titles that need their full text on hover or focus, rather than a tooltip on every item, and see the Truncated Text recipe for labels inside buttons and clamped lines.
